summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing receipt of Class III medical device approval from China's National Medical Products Administration for its ProSense cryoablation system and associated cryoprobes, enabling marketing in China under the approved registration. CEO Eyal Shamir commented on the milestone. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are involved; this is a routine regulatory-milestone current report equivalent to a US Form 8-K product-approval disclosure. What to watch: commercialization timing and revenue contribution in China, not deal arbitrage.
